# Changes made for PotARCin

This directory is a copy of [google/ARC-GEN](https://github.com/google/ARC-GEN) (Apache License 2.0, see `LICENSE`), taken in March 2026. PotARCin changed the files below so that each generator can reproduce its task's training demonstrations and test pairs. All other files are unchanged.
